entries.want: Get a long draft, README or explanation written clearly and faithfully
entries.neighbor: `/bro`, which repairs only the agent's last answer

entries.want: Have the last answer said plainly
entries.neighbor: `/wait-what`, which explains one point with your context

entries.want: Understand one point in the last answer that lost me
entries.neighbor: `/teach`, which builds a whole layered explanation

entries.want: Make my request deeper, not bigger, before anyone works on it
entries.neighbor: `grilling`, which settles decisions instead of rewriting the prompt

entries.want: Know how this code runs today
entries.neighbor: `why`, which explains history and intent

entries.want: Know why it was built this way, or whether a note matches what someone decided
entries.prompt: "why does the cache expire after 90 seconds?"
entries.neighbor: `how`, which traces current behavior only

entries.want: Learn a concept in layers, or save a course
entries.neighbor: `how` and `why`, which it uses underneath

entries.want: Answer a technical question from primary sources
entries.prompt: "find out from the Postgres docs whether ..."
entries.neighbor: `how`, for questions the code itself answers

entries.want: Be interviewed until the plan is settled, with no files written
entries.prompt: "grill me on this plan", "stress-test this design"
entries.neighbor: `/grill-me`, the typed shortcut to the same interview

entries.want: The same interview, started by command
entries.neighbor: `/grill-with-docs`, which writes glossary terms and ADRs

entries.want: Be interviewed and have terms and decisions recorded as they settle
entries.neighbor: `domain-modeling`, which edits the glossary or ADRs directly; missing project paths allow a plain interview without document writes

entries.want: Fix a term conflict, record a definition, rename a concept, or record or supersede an ADR
entries.neighbor: `decision-log`, which records choices inside one agent run

entries.want: Plan a goal too big and unclear for one session
entries.neighbor: `/to-tickets`, which splits an already approved spec

entries.want: Ask another person what only they know
entries.neighbor: `research`, which reads sources instead of asking people

entries.want: Try a state model or UI before building it
entries.neighbor: `architect`, which designs the real interface

entries.want: Turn an agreed plan into a spec with stories, Acceptance and Proof
entries.neighbor: `grilling`, which settles the plan first; `/to-spec` never interviews

entries.want: Split an approved spec into vertical-slice tickets
entries.neighbor: `work-decomposition`, which imports tickets into an execution plan

entries.want: Triage new issues and external PRs
entries.neighbor: `/to-tickets`, which writes new tickets from a spec

entries.want: Record a project's tracker, labels and domain paths
entries.neighbor: `project-guardrails`, which sets up checks, not the planning contract

entries.want: Improve one module's interface or test seam
entries.prompt: "make this module deeper", "where should the seam go?"
entries.neighbor: `architect`, which compares whole alternative designs

entries.want: Compare interface designs and record the chosen one
entries.prompt: "design the interface for the export service"
entries.neighbor: `codebase-design`, the vocabulary it builds on

entries.want: Find refactors worth doing across a codebase
entries.neighbor: `architect`, which designs one chosen candidate

entries.want: Know what a change could break beyond its diff
entries.prompt: "what's the blast radius of this change?"
entries.neighbor: `change-review`, which judges the diff itself

entries.want: Build one ticket or agreed change, proved and self-reviewed
entries.neighbor: `/implement-spec`, which runs the whole ticket graph

entries.want: Build a whole approved ticket graph with workers
entries.neighbor: `agent-orchestrator`, which routes approved code tickets to it

entries.want: Work test-first or add a regression test
entries.neighbor: `diagnosing-bugs`, which first finds the cause

entries.want: Find the real cause of a bug or slowdown
entries.neighbor: `fix-ci`, which handles a failing CI check

entries.want: Walk a human through steps only they can do
entries.prompt: "make a setup wizard for the API keys"
entries.neighbor: `create-verification-skill`, which the agent itself runs

entries.want: Check a speedup or latency claim before believing it
entries.neighbor: `diagnosing-bugs`, which finds a regression's cause

entries.want: A report on a change against standards and the spec, without fixes
entries.neighbor: Claude Code's built-in `/code-review` and `/review`, which keep their own behavior

entries.want: Review, fix and recheck in bounded rounds
entries.prompt: "run a sol loop on this PR"
entries.neighbor: `change-review`, its report-only primitive

entries.want: A panel of different providers on one question
entries.prompt: review this with Claude and Codex
entries.neighbor: `agent-debate`, which `/council` uses for design questions

entries.want: An adversarial review that tries to break the change, report only
entries.neighbor: `sol-loop`, which also fixes what it finds

entries.want: Accept or reject agents' work on evidence
entries.prompt: "check the workers' results before we merge"
entries.neighbor: `change-review`, which judges code quality, not delivery claims

entries.want: A project skill that launches and drives the real app
entries.prompt: "make a driver that proves the CLI end to end"
entries.neighbor: `project-guardrails`, which wires deterministic checks

entries.want: Audit an existing driver for drift and coverage
entries.neighbor: `create-verification-skill`, which writes a new driver

entries.want: A PR title and body, drafted or filed
entries.neighbor: `/pr`, which drafts by default and files when the same request or existing task authority permits it

entries.want: A PR body as a local draft, by command
entries.neighbor: `file-pr`, which can file when the same request or existing task authority permits it

entries.want: A PR watched until it is ready
entries.neighbor: `/full-send`, which also merges

entries.want: A failing CI check fixed for the right reason
entries.neighbor: `diagnosing-bugs`, which it calls for hard failures

entries.want: Review comments verified and answered
entries.neighbor: `babysit-pr`, which uses it in a full pass

entries.want: An old or conflicted PR brought up to date
entries.neighbor: `takeover`, which also changes who owns the work

entries.want: Someone else's PR or branch finished
entries.prompt: "take over this PR and finish it"
entries.neighbor: `modernize`, which only updates it

entries.want: A change taken all the way to merged
entries.neighbor: `/full-stop`, which stops at ready

entries.want: A change taken to a ready PR, not merged
entries.neighbor: `babysit-pr`, which watches a PR you already have

entries.want: Run a multi-agent effort with one coordinator
entries.neighbor: `/implement-spec`, the single runner for approved code tickets

entries.want: Decide whether delegating pays, and plan owners and a budget
entries.neighbor: `/to-tickets`, which writes the tickets themselves

entries.want: Write a brief a fresh agent can run without our chat
entries.prompt: "write a brief for a worker to ..."
entries.neighbor: `/handoff`, which continues this conversation

entries.want: Have agents debate, or get a second opinion
entries.prompt: "have two agents debate this", "get a second opinion"
entries.neighbor: `change-review`, which owns code review

entries.want: Keep a run record that survives compaction
entries.prompt: "keep a durable record of this run"
entries.neighbor: `/handoff`, a temporary note, and `domain-modeling`, for project ADRs

entries.want: Set up or audit format, lint, types, tests, CI and hooks
entries.neighbor: `correct`, which fixes one recurring mistake

entries.want: Upgrade lint, format or type tooling without silent drift
entries.neighbor: `project-guardrails`, which assesses what is enforced

entries.want: Make a mistake that keeps recurring fail a check
entries.neighbor: `/retro`, which finds improvements from one session

entries.want: Write or fix agent instructions: SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md
entries.neighbor: `clear-communication`, for writing aimed at people

groups.heading: Continue, catch up and look back

entries.want: Hand the work to a fresh session
entries.neighbor: `decision-log`, the durable record a handoff points to

entries.want: Find an earlier run whose link I lost
entries.prompt: "find the run where we fixed the importer"
entries.neighbor: `decision-log`, which resumes a run you can already locate

entries.want: Catch up on what happened since my last message
entries.neighbor: `recall`, which searches older history

entries.want: Review how a session went and what to improve
entries.neighbor: `correct`, which acts on a recurrence
